## What this dashboard shows

- This dashboard demonstrates how an ontology spine answers questions about group ownership, control, and economic interest across 11 consolidated entities and 5 ERP ledgers.
- Group EBITDA is ₹681.84B (Jan 2024–Jul 2026, after eliminations, from the CFO Cockpit).
- Of 11 entities, 9 are 100% owned; 2 are joint ventures (GE Healthcare at 49% and Kawasaki Precision Machinery at 51%), all consolidated using the full method, resulting in Wipro's share at stake of ₹628.76B.

## What to report

- All 11 entities are consolidated in full, delivering group EBITDA of ₹681.84B (Jan 2024–Jul 2026, post-eliminations).
- Wipro's economic share of EBITDA is ₹628.76B, reflecting 9 wholly-owned entities plus minority stakes in 2 JVs (GE Healthcare 49%, Kawasaki Precision Machinery 51%).
- The group operates across 5 ERP ledgers: SAP S/4HANA (A) ₹338.90B, SAP S/4HANA (B) ₹120.22B, Oracle EBS ₹117.14B, Dynamics 365 ₹67.79B, and Tally Prime ₹37.81B, totalling ₹681.86B before eliminations.
- Intercompany eliminations of ₹9.59B revenue have been removed from two trading pairs (WIN1 to WKPM: 292 documents, 290 matched; WIN1 to Wipro Consumer Care India - South: 296 documents, 294 matched).

## Watch out for

- Companies 2–5 are simulated and sized against real SAP company 1; stakes and consolidation methods (full method for all entities, including the 49% and 51% JVs) follow the demo set-up.
- EBITDA at Wipro stake (₹628.76B) is derived (stake × EBITDA) and is not shown on the CFO Cockpit—verify the calculation methodology and whether this metric should be board-reported.
- Both JVs are consolidated at 100% despite minority stakes (GE Healthcare 49%, Kawasaki 51%)—confirm this reflects actual control rights and accounting treatment, not just the demo configuration.
- A ₹0.02B difference exists between pre-elimination EBITDA (₹681.86B from Executive Overview) and post-elimination (₹681.84B from CFO Cockpit)—clarify whether all intercompany profit eliminations are captured.
